title: Inventory concurrency review
Constrained cart substitution
prompt: Choose a substitute for a synthetic grocery cart. Return only one minified JSON object with exactly the keys substitute_sku, quantity, and reason_code. The shopper needs two 32 oz cartons, is vegan, has a severe peanut allergy, and accepts at most a $1.00 increase per carton. The unavailable original costs $4.99. Candidates: OAT-32={vegan:true,allergens:[],size_oz:32,stock:2,price:5.49}; DAIRY-32={vegan:false,allergens:[],size_oz:32,stock:8,price:4.49}; PB-OAT-32={vegan:true,allergens:[peanut],size_oz:32,stock:6,price:4.99}; OAT-16={vegan:true,allergens:[],size_oz:16,stock:4,price:2.99}. Allowed reason_code values: exact_constraint_match or no_safe_substitute.

title: Order exception classification
prompt: Classify three synthetic grocery order exceptions. Return only one minified JSON object whose keys are order-17, order-18, and order-19. Allowed values: cold_chain, fraud_review, courier_delay, or no_action. Rules: temperature above 41F for more than 30 minutes => cold_chain; at least 5 payment retries plus billing mismatch => fraud_review; courier more than 20 minutes late while food remains safe => courier_delay. Events: order-17 temperature=46F duration=38m; order-18 payment_retries=6 billing_mismatch=true; order-19 courier_late=25m food_safe=true.
